title: Dashboard Language Chain
description: Where the dashboard takes its language from when no preference event, environment override or argument names one. `systemVariables` are read in order and the first one that names a supported language wins (`de_DE.UTF-8`, `de-AT` and `de@euro` all name `de`; `C` and `POSIX` name none). `fallback` lists supported languages in preference order and the first one is used when the system names none; the code holds no language of its own.
